Task complete. Final verify passes:

```
node --import tsx --test tests/scope-resolver-upgrade.test.ts \
  tests/scope-recertification.test.ts tests/retry-recertification.test.ts \

ℹ tests 49   ℹ pass 49   ℹ fail 0
```

## Summary

Implemented all seven acceptance lines within `scope`:

- **`src/watcher/outcome.ts`** — `DoneMarkerMetadata.scopeResolver`; `writeDoneMarker` emits `scope_resolver: 2` beside `scope_hash`/`scope_files`; timestamp-only markers unchanged.
- **`src/watcher/regression.ts`** — `buildDoneMetadata` records resolver 2; `auditScopeRegressions` treats an absent/malformed/non-2 resolver as stale even with a matching aggregate hash, records `recorded_resolver`/`current_resolver` in the marker and `recordedResolver`/`currentResolver` in the `regressed` event, and reports no differing paths for a version-only upgrade.
- **`src/harness/types.ts`** — typed resolver fields on `RegressedEventData`.
- **`src/core/retry.ts`** — passing recertification rebuilds the done marker with `scope_resolver: 2` while preserving body/unknown metadata; failed recertification still requeues.
- **`README.md`** — one `## Upgrading` note covering the one-time wave, detection verify, `osq retry <id> <task>`, and untouched archive markers.
- **`tests/scope-resolver-upgrade.test.ts`** (new) — 10 tests covering ordinary completion, version-only and glob-differing legacy markers, idempotency, wrong/malformed versions, manual exclusion, pre-archive blocking, passing and failed recertification, archive byte-stability, and the README note.

`pnpm tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm lint` are clean. The full suite is 1067 pass / 2 fail, the two failures being the pre-existing `golden-events` `repoLines` fixture mismatches documented by task 1 (unrelated to this change). Results written to `.run/results/2.md`.
